note: Independent re-audit against RFC 7854 Section 3.3 ('Once it has sent all the routes for a given peer, it MUST send an End-of-RIB message for that peer') and Section 5 at HEAD. primeSender -> replayPeerLocked (bmp_events.go, bmp_replay.go) emits Peer Up, replays surviving routes, then writes per-family EOR markers via buildEndOfRIBBody; any replayErr aborts without EOR and closes the collector. Positive TestRFC7854AdjReplayEndsEachFamily asserts the exact 4-message wire stream: PeerUp, surviving route only (withdrawn route excluded), IPv4 EOR, IPv6 EOR. Negatives: TestRFC7854AdjReplayCompletionIsSessionScoped proves a second collector's snapshot leaves a settled collector untouched and an incremental UPDATE emits no EOR; TestRFC7854IncompleteAdjReplayCannotClaimCompletion proves replayErr emits zero EORs and closes the collector.
